articles.title: Wells Fargo's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings double to $2.35 billion
articles.description: The bank's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF position doubled to $2.35 billion in the third quarter, giving it exposure to roughly 28,000 BTC.

articles.title: Third U.S. carrier arrives in the Gulf, stoking concerns about renewed conflicts with Iran
articles.description: Iran has ratcheted up threats against U.S. forces as a third American aircraft carrier arrived in the Gulf, stoking fears of a resumption of military tensions.

articles.title: Ripple-backed Evernorth has written down its pre-listing XRP holdings by 60%
articles.description: The company’s accounting policy requires it to record price declines without reversing those write-downs when XRP recovers.

articles.title: Trezor customer data exposed in 3rd partner breach this year
articles.description: Trezor warned an attacker has been able to access customer names, phone numbers and delivery addresses linked to 27,000 orders from one of its shipping providers.

articles.title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
articles.description: Ledger and Coinpass were among the businesses whose websites served malware designed to steal visitors’ crypto and credit card details, according to security researchers.

articles.title: Analysis: The Fed's chairman sees an AI revolution coming. Now he has to figure out what it means
articles.description: Kevin Warsh sees AI at a turning point. He faces tough questions on jobs and interest rates.

articles.title: United Airlines resolves system outage that affected departing flights
articles.description: The airline said there was no impact on flights in progress and there was no indication the outage was a cyberattack.

articles.title: Nvidia shares fall 4% as board reportedly rules out Huang return
articles.description: The chipmaker’s board is reportedly focused on investigating Huang’s conduct, even as a petition calling for his reinstatement gathers more than 187,000 signatures.

articles.title: Jim Cramer says Nvidia’s leadership shake-up won’t derail the AI trade
articles.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer pushed back against fears that Nvidia's leadership shake-up could unravel the AI boom.

articles.title: Aschenbrenner’s Situational Awareness made AI bets again before October rout
articles.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, which almost collapsed over the summer, bought AI stocks before shares began tumbling.

articles.title: Berkshire Hathaway raised its stake in Delta in the third quarter. It also trimmed a key bank holding
articles.description: Berkshire Hathaway added to several stock positions in the third quarter while trimming others, including Bank of America.

articles.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: As Nike and Lululemon struggle in China, Xiaohongshu is helping local brands take off
articles.description: There's one formula for success behind the rise of trendy new Chinese fashion brands, according to Euromonitor International.

articles.title: Custodia Bank loses Supreme Court bid for direct Fed payment access
articles.description: The Supreme Court refused to hear Custodia Bank’s appeal, meaning a lower court ruling allowing the Fed to reject account applications will stand.

articles.title: German lawmakers back crypto freezes outside criminal cases
articles.description: Customs authorities could hold “suspicious” assets for 30 days under the bill, with court oversight for extensions and disputed confiscation.

articles.title: Alibaba's Qwen 4 Max Leads China's AI Agent Race—But You Can't Download It
articles.description: Alibaba's new flagship jumps ahead of Chinese rivals on agent and web design leaderboards, with cheaper API access. The closed model also previews the next generation of open Qwen releases.

articles.title: Trump’s accounts traded up to $97.5 million in Nvidia as Huang gained White House access
articles.description: Trump’s accounts sold up to $1 million in Nvidia stock five days after he was briefed on Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.

articles.title: Binance hack may push institutions to outside custody, FalconX exec says
articles.description: FalconX’s Joshua Lim says the Binance hack could push institutions to keep crypto off exchanges and change how large investors trade in 2027.

articles.title: U.S. crude oil declines to $85 a barrel on recovering Middle East exports
articles.description: Oil prices are falling as forecasts project a surplus in oil in the fourth quarter

articles.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Trezor Says Customer Data Was Exposed Again
articles.description: A second Trezor shipping partner was breached in three months, exposing buyers' addresses and order details.

articles.title: JPMorgan Chase says temporary software bug is affecting consumer banking
articles.description: CNBC's Eamon Javers reported there was no indication of bad actors involved and likewise no indication that a bug was impacting multiple banks at the same time.
